changelog.title: What's new
changelog.subtitle: What changes in the game, newest first.

items.cards: Redesigned cards: metal frame, aura and holo sheen growing with the rarity.
items.back: Click a card to see it up close, tilt it and flip it: statistics, career, biography and credits are on the back.
items.sort: Collection sortable by rarity, date obtained, number, name, age or country.
items.reveal: The rarest cards come out last, with a burst of light in their color.
items.tube: New ball tube: clear plastic, felt balls, glossy label.
items.catalog: Only players with a photo, and many more tour players.
items.transition: A more spectacular opening: the tube trembles, a beam of light shoots out, the cards fly toward you and land one by one in the stack.

items.reveal: New opening: cards come out face up, stacked. Their halo hints at a pair of rarities, and their frame shows the exact rarity once on top. Spin the tube with your mouse or finger.
items.photos: Photos framed on the face, and taken during their career for retired players.
items.golden: Golden booster: about one booster in 20, guaranteed by the 30th at the latest. Its last card is better.
items.pity: Top rarity guaranteed by the 300th booster at the latest, with a visible counter.
items.daily: Free daily booster, with a theme that follows the tennis calendar.
items.pools: Choice of free booster: All, Men or Women.
items.collection: Collection page: nation albums, collections, wishlist, one-click recycling, grading.
items.missions: Missions: 7-day login streak, daily missions, first steps and achievements.
items.social: Public profile with a showcase, shared pulls, big pulls feed, referral.
items.trial: Trial without an account: two boosters before signing up.
